model.description: Specify the model to use for the main chat

set-env.description: Set an environment variable (to control API settings, can be used multiple times)

api-key.description: Set an API key for a provider (eg: --api-key provider=<key> sets PROVIDER_API_KEY=<key>)

list-models.description: List known models which match the (partial) MODEL name

alias.description: Add a model alias (can be used multiple times)

reasoning-effort.description: Set the reasoning_effort API parameter (default: not set)

thinking-tokens.description: Set the thinking token budget for models that support it. Use 0 to disable. (default: not set)

verify-ssl.description: Verify the SSL cert when connecting to models (default: True)

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for API calls (default: None)

edit-format.description: Specify what edit format the LLM should use (default depends on model)

architect.description: Use architect edit format for the main chat

auto-accept-architect.description: Enable/disable automatic acceptance of architect changes (default: True)

weak-model.description: Specify the model to use for commit messages and chat history summarization (default depends on --model)

editor-model.description: Specify the model to use for editor tasks (default depends on --model)

editor-edit-format.description: Specify the edit format for the editor model (default: depends on editor model)

show-model-warnings.description: Only work with models that have meta-data available (default: True)

check-model-accepts-settings.description: Check if model accepts settings like reasoning_effort/thinking_tokens (default: True)

max-chat-history-tokens.description: Soft limit on tokens for chat history, after which summarization begins. If unspecified, defaults to the model's max_chat_history_tokens.

cache-keepalive-pings.description: Number of times to ping at 5min intervals to keep prompt cache warm (default: 0)

map-tokens.description: Suggested number of tokens to use for repo map, use 0 to disable

map-refresh.description: Control how often the repo map is refreshed. Options: auto, always, files, manual (default: auto)

map-multiplier-no-files.description: Multiplier for map tokens when no files are specified (default: 2)

restore-chat-history.description: Restore the previous chat history messages (default: False)

dark-mode.description: Use colors suitable for a dark terminal background (default: False)

light-mode.description: Use colors suitable for a light terminal background (default: False)

user-input-color.description: Set the color for user input (default: #00cc00)

tool-output-color.description: Set the color for tool output (default: None)

tool-error-color.description: Set the color for tool error messages (default: #FF2222)

tool-warning-color.description: Set the color for tool warning messages (default: #FFA500)

assistant-output-color.description: Set the color for assistant output (default: #0088ff)

completion-menu-color.description: Set the color for the completion menu (default: terminal's default text color)

completion-menu-bg-color.description: Set the background color for the completion menu (default: terminal's default background color)

completion-menu-current-color.description: Set the color for the current item in the completion menu (default: terminal's default background color)

completion-menu-current-bg-color.description: Set the background color for the current item in the completion menu (default: terminal's default text color)

code-theme.description: Set the markdown code theme (default: default, other options include monokai, solarized-dark, solarized-light, or a Pygments builtin style, see https://pygments.org/styles for available themes)

show-diffs.description: Show diffs when committing changes (default: False)

git.description: Enable/disable looking for a git repo (default: True)

add-gitignore-files.description: Enable/disable the addition of files listed in .gitignore to Aider's editing scope.

subtree-only.description: Only consider files in the current subtree of the git repository

auto-commits.description: Enable/disable auto commit of LLM changes (default: True)

dirty-commits.description: Enable/disable commits when repo is found dirty (default: True)

attribute-author.description: Attribute aider code changes in the git author name (default: True). If explicitly set to True, overrides --attribute-co-authored-by precedence.

attribute-committer.description: Attribute aider commits in the git committer name (default: True). If explicitly set to True, overrides --attribute-co-authored-by precedence for aider edits.

attribute-commit-message-author.description: Prefix commit messages with 'aider: ' if aider authored the changes (default: False)

attribute-commit-message-committer.description: Prefix all commit messages with 'aider: ' (default: False)

attribute-co-authored-by.description: Attribute aider edits using the Co-authored-by trailer in the commit message (default: True). If True, this takes precedence over default --attribute-author and --attribute-committer behavior unless they are explicitly set to True.

git-commit-verify.description: Enable/disable git pre-commit hooks with --no-verify (default: False)

commit.description: Commit all pending changes with a suitable commit message, then exit

commit-prompt.description: Specify a custom prompt for generating commit messages

dry-run.description: Perform a dry run without modifying files (default: False)

skip-sanity-check-repo.description: Skip the sanity check for the git repository (default: False)

watch-files.description: Enable/disable watching files for ai coding comments (default: False)

lint.description: Lint and fix provided files, or dirty files if none provided

lint-cmd.description: Specify lint commands to run for different languages, eg: "python: flake8 --select=..." (can be used multiple times)

auto-lint.description: Enable/disable automatic linting after changes (default: True)

auto-test.description: Enable/disable automatic testing after changes (default: False)

test.description: Run tests, fix problems found and then exit

analytics.description: Enable/disable analytics for current session (default: random)

analytics-posthog-host.description: Send analytics to custom PostHog instance

analytics-posthog-project-api-key.description: Send analytics to custom PostHog project

just-check-update.description: Check for updates and return status in the exit code

check-update.description: Check for new aider versions on launch

show-release-notes.description: Show release notes on first run of new version (default: None, ask user)

install-main-branch.description: Install the latest version from the main branch

upgrade.description: Upgrade aider to the latest version from PyPI

version.description: Show the version number and exit

message.description: Specify a single message to send the LLM, process reply then exit (disables chat mode)

gui.description: Run aider in your browser (default: False)

copy-paste.description: Enable automatic copy/paste of chat between aider and web UI (default: False)

apply-clipboard-edits.description: Apply clipboard contents as edits using the main model's editor format

exit.description: Do all startup activities then exit before accepting user input (debug)

show-repo-map.description: Print the repo map and exit (debug)

show-prompts.description: Print the system prompts and exit (debug)

voice-format.description: Audio format for voice recording (default: wav). webm and mp3 require ffmpeg

voice-language.description: Specify the language for voice using ISO 639-1 code (default: auto)

voice-input-device.description: Specify the input device name for voice recording

disable-playwright.description: Never prompt for or attempt to install Playwright for web scraping (default: False).

vim.description: Use VI editing mode in the terminal (default: False)

chat-language.description: Specify the language to use in the chat (default: None, uses system settings)

commit-language.description: Specify the language to use in the commit message (default: None, user language)

yes-always.description: Always say yes to every confirmation

encoding.description: Specify the encoding for input and output (default: utf-8)

line-endings.description: Line endings to use when writing files (default: platform)

fancy-input.description: Enable/disable fancy input with history and completion (default: True)

multiline.description: Enable/disable multi-line input mode with Meta-Enter to submit (default: False)

notifications.description: Enable/disable terminal bell notifications when LLM responses are ready (default: False)

notifications-command.description: Specify a command to run for notifications instead of the terminal bell. If not specified, a default command for your OS may be used.

detect-urls.description: Enable/disable detection and offering to add URLs to chat (default: True)

editor.description: Specify which editor to use for the /editor command

model-settings-file.description: Specify a file with aider model settings for unknown models

model-metadata-file.description: Specify a file with context window and costs for unknown models

llm-history-file.description: Log the conversation with the LLM to this file (for example, .aider.llm.history)

aiderignore.description: Specify the aider ignore file (default: .aiderignore in git root)

analytics-log.description: Specify a file to log analytics events

message-file.description: Specify a file containing the message to send the LLM, process reply, then exit (disables chat mode)

apply.description: Apply the changes from the given file instead of running the chat (debug)

file.description: specify a file to edit (can be used multiple times)

read.description: specify a read-only file (can be used multiple times)

load.description: Load and execute /commands from a file on launch

config.description: Specify the config file (default: search for .aider.conf.yml in git root, cwd or home directory)

env-file.description: Specify the .env file to load (default: .env in git root)
